message.content:
You need to build a complete Python script that generates an interactive HTML mockup file. The file should be written to `/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/mnt/outputs/interactive-mockup.html`.

CONTEXT: This is a design system tool for an IB Resume scoring website. It has:
1. A tab bar at the top with tabs: Design Compare, Landing, Upload, About You, Target Banks, Results
2. The Design Compare tab contains 20 sections with 8 clickable cards each (160 total cards)
3. A floating draggable control panel with dropdowns
4. A Global Colors section with color pickers
5. A Save/Export button

CRITICAL: Read the current file first to understand the existing structure:
- Read `/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/mnt/outputs/interactive-mockup.html` (1481 lines)

Then build a Python script at `/sessions/stoic-relaxed-carson/build_complete.py` that generates the COMPLETE new version.

The current file has 14 DC sections. It needs to have exactly 20 sections matching the original design-compare.html. The missing sections that need to be ADDED are:

Section 7 (currently missing) — Text Color Palette: Body + heading + label text variations
- Cards: Blue-Gray (Current), Warm Stone, High Contrast, Earth Tones, Cool Neutral, Warm Cream, Monochrome White, Amber Tinted
- CSS var: text-primary (heading color changes)

Section 9 (currently missing) — CTA Button: The "Continue" button styles
- Cards: Gold Filled + Arrow (Current), Ghost Outline, White Minimal, Underline Only, Gold Filled Sharp, Subtle Gray Fill, Gold Gradient Fill, Double Border Gold
- This is a visual-only comparison section

Section 10 (currently missing) — Full Hero Heading Treatment: Complete heading with label + title + accent
- Cards: Sans + Serif Italic (Current), Full Cormorant Serif, Weight Contrast Only, Space Grotesk + Lora, Helvetica All-Caps, Full Libre Baskerville, Inter + Lora Mix, Mono Brutalist
- This is a visual-only comparison section

Section 12 (currently missing) — Bank Ticker Bar: Scrolling bank names
- Cards: DM Sans (Current), Helvetica Neue Tight, JetBrains Mono, IBM Plex Sans Light, Space Grotesk, Inconsolata, Inter Small, Fira Code Terminal
- This is a visual-only comparison section

Section 19 (currently missing) — Section Headers: "BANK FIT ANALYSIS" etc
- Cards: Bold Uppercase White (Current), Mono + Bottom Divider, Left Gold Border, Overline Rule, Large Serif, Number Prefixed, Dash-Separated, Brackets Mono

Section 20 (currently missing) — Top Navigation Bar: "IB Resume BA" logo + buttons
- Cards: Instrument Serif + Round (Current), Cormorant + Sharp Mono, Plex Bold + Text Links, Space Grotesk + Underline, JetBrains Mono Terminal, Libre Baskerville + Ghost, Playfair + Pill Buttons, Lora Serif + Gold Btns

APPROACH:
1. Read the current file completely
2. Write a Python script that:
   - Keeps ALL existing CSS, JavaScript, tab structure, page content, floating panel, color pickers, and save/export
   - Replaces the Design Compare content to have ALL 20 sections in the correct order matching the original:
     1. Heading Font
     2. Accent Font ("Unfiltered.")
     3. Body / Description Font
     4. Stat Numbers & Labels
     5. Page Background
     6. Form Card Background
     7. Text Color Palette (NEW)
     8. Border Radius
     9. CTA Button (NEW)
     10. Full Hero Heading Treatment (NEW)
     11. Gold Accent Color
     12. Bank Ticker Bar (NEW)
     13. Score Display
     14. Severity Badges
     15. Progress Bars
     16. Issue Cards
     17. Before → After Rewrites (currently missing - ADD)
     18. Bank Fit Indicators (currently missing - ADD)
     19. Section Headers (NEW)
     20. Top Navigation Bar (NEW)

For EXISTING sections, keep them as they are in the current file. For NEW sections, create cards with the proper visual previews matching the original source. Each card needs:
- `data-section="sectionN"` attribute
- `data-var` and `data-val` attributes for sections that map to CSS variables
- For visual-only sections that don't map to a single CSS variable, still make them clickable but they can be informational
- The card HTML structure: `.dc-card` > `.dc-label` (name + tag) > `.dc-preview` (visual) > `.dc-meta` (code info)

Also ensure a Part 2 divider appears between section 12 and 13, labeled "Results Page Elements".

The Python script should:
1. Read the existing file
2. Parse out the CSS, JS, and non-DC-tab content
3. Rebuild the DC tab content with all 20 sections
4. Write the complete file

Make the script robust. Run it after writing. Verify the output file has all 20 section titles.

IMPORTANT: The visual content of each card should render ACTUAL styled elements (not just text descriptions). For example, the Text Color Palette cards should show actual heading/body/label text in those colors. The CTA Button cards should show actual styled buttons. Use inline styles just like the original.

After running the script, verify with: grep "dc-section-title" output_file | wc -l (should be 21 — 20 sections + 1 "Global Color Palette")
